prompt:
Improve this list by restating them in your own words:

An abstract strategy board game for two players ​

The aim is to surround more territory than the opponent ​

The game is played mainly on a 19x19 grid of lines ​

Each player has an army of stones of two colors, black and white​

Go originated in China over 3,000 years ago and is believed to be the oldest board game continuously played to the present day. Winning this board game requires multiple layers of strategic thinking.​

A 2016 survey by the International Go Federation's 75 member nations found that there are over 46 million people worldwide who know how to play Go and over 20 million current players, the majority of whom live in East Asia.​
response: Go is a two-player abstract strategy game where the objective is to encircle more territory than your opponent on a 19x19 grid. Each player uses an army of stones, either black or white, to achieve this. The game has been played in China for over 3,000 years and is considered the oldest continuously played board game. A 2016 survey by the International Go Federation's 75 member nations revealed that over 46 million people know how to play Go, with over 20 million active players, mostly in East Asia.
